_why: Every payload path the backend may legitimately send as null, declared in one
place and read by BOTH suites.
This file exists because the same bug shipped twice in one session. The
backend widened a value to null; the zod schema still said z.number(); the
parse failed and took the entire profile page down for 9 members. Both times
the Python suite and the TypeScript suite were fully green, because every
fixture in them was written by hand and nobody imagines the awkward case.
The rule this encodes: widening a backend value to null is a WIRE CHANGE,
even when no field is renamed and no key moves.
Adding a path here is one line. Forgetting to is caught by the fixture test,
which derives observed nulls from real captured payloads rather than from

nullable_paths.mp.party: The member sits in no faction. True of the Seimo Pirmininkas, who steps out of his by convention, and of every former member. 9 members today.
nullable_paths.metrics.party_loyalty: No faction to agree with, or too few comparable votes. Not a low score — no basis.
nullable_paths.metrics.attendance_percentage: Suppressed below the 3 eligible sitting day floor.
nullable_paths.forensic_breakdown.loyalty_bonus.indepen: The loyalty engine is unavailable, so there is no independence rate to report. Must never be inverted from a missing figure.
nullable_paths.forensic_breakdown.benford.p_value: Too few digits to run the test.
nullable_paths.forensic_breakdown.vote_geometry.max_dev: No geometry computed for this member.
nullable_paths.forensic_breakdown.phantom_network.close: No phantom-network hit, so there is no hop distance.
nullable_paths.mp.active: politicians.is_active is a nullable column. No row has it null today; one would have blanked that member's profile.
nullable_paths.mp.photo: politicians.photo_url is nullable. Same shape as mp.active — latent rather than live.
nullable_paths.mp.seimas_id: The LRS person id is absent for a row not yet reconciled with the members feed.
nullable_paths.mp.mandate_start_date: Mandate window unknown — an empty or partially-ingested members table.
nullable_paths.mp.last_synced_at: Never synced; only reachable on a fresh database.
nullable_paths.metrics.bills_initiated_total: The authored-bills feed has not run, so the count is unknown rather than zero.
nullable_paths.metrics.bills_initiated_individually: Same feed. Zero here would claim the member initiated nothing alone, which is the stronger claim migration 021 warned about.
